name: Baba ganoush
description: Charred eggplant whipped with tahini, lemon and garlic.

tcm.note: Eggplant is cool; the tahini and garlic warm it.

ayurveda.note: Vrintaka is ushna, and the tahini adds to it.

unani.note: Baingan is garam in the eastern reading; the lemon does not cool it much.

histamine.note: Eggplant plus lemon — eggplant alone sits high on the SIGHI list.
